rituals.title: Two Taps on the Outer Iron
rituals.description: Before an expedition steps into the airlock, the leader or scout taps the steel casing twice with bare knuckles. A quiet habit that signals transition between the sealed shelter and the contaminated exterior.

rituals.title: The Outside Crumb
rituals.description: A survivor leaves a single charred crust or dry pea on the outer sill during airlock cycling. Symbolizes acknowledgment that living things outside are starving too.

rituals.title: The Birthday Match
rituals.description: On a recorded birthday, the dweller is permitted a single wooden match struck in the dark dormitory, watched in silence until the sulphur burns down to the fingers.

rituals.title: The Roster Plate Touch
rituals.description: Scouts place a flat palm against the brass station plate listing former crew numbers before stepping across the threshold.

rituals.title: The Return Count
rituals.description: Immediately upon the inner hatch latching, returning expedition members speak their surnames in sequence to confirm all boots crossed the threshold.

rituals.title: The Wellhead Pause
rituals.description: When a new batch of filtered water passes chemical assay, the filter operator and bystanders hold a three-second silence before drinking.

rituals.title: The Bereaved Spoon
rituals.description: Following the loss of a dweller, the mess hall observes ten seconds of silence with spoons held upside-down before eating.

rituals.title: The Generator Wrench Knock
rituals.description: Habitual three taps with a brass spanner on the generator's flywheel shroud before flipping the starter solenoid.

rituals.title: Intake Vent Dread
rituals.description: Belief that sleeping within three paces of the main intake duct pulls black dreams and sickness from the surface filters into the sleeper's mind.

rituals.title: The Unbroken Bunk
rituals.description: Conviction that Bunk Four Lower has never lost an occupant to outside expedition failure, causing dispute when new arrivals are assigned to it.

rituals.title: Unspoken on Departure
rituals.description: Taboo forbidding anyone from speaking an expedition scout's name out loud between the outer hatch opening and closing.

rituals.title: The Turbine's Sleep
rituals.description: Belief that the water circulation impeller should never be serviced between three and five in the morning, creating friction with emergency repair shifts.

rituals.title: The 94.2 Bad Frequency
rituals.description: Conviction that stopping the dial on 94.2 MHz causes filter degradation or severe storms within forty-eight hours.

rituals.title: The Hot Lead Charm
rituals.description: Carrying a spent solder blob or casing from an expedition despite mild rad-click detection, believing it deflects greater fallout.

rituals.title: Red-Light Freeze Rhyme Comfort
rituals.description: During sudden blackout, an older sibling recites the red-light rhyme, preventing panic and keeping young dwellers stationary until emergency power clicks on.

rituals.title: Deep-Cold Lullaby Comfort
rituals.description: When sub-zero weather chills the shelter walls, collective singing of the deep-cold song settles dormitory shivering and raises spirits.

rituals.title: Under-Bunk Mark for Lost Parent
rituals.description: A bereaved child is guided to scratch a small circle and letter beneath the mattress board, easing solitary grief through quiet ritual.

rituals.title: Return Count for Shaken Scout
rituals.description: A traumatized scout returning from an encounter is grounded as the children at the hatch recite their name in the return tally.

rituals.title: Hot Zone Rite of Committal
rituals.description: A solemn expedition ritual observed by scavenging cults and wasteland dwellers before venturing into high-rad sectors.
